Reopen replaces the current form with the last saved copy and discards unsaved edits. Retry keeping edits reads the saved copy while retaining your entered fields and pauses automatic saving. If the saved copy changed or cannot be matched, saving stays blocked. Keep edits returns without reading or changing anything.
Saving earlier changes… Newer edits are not saved yet.
Unsaved changes. Valid edits save after a short pause; Save locally saves them now.
Automatic saving is paused. Your visible edits are retained; tap Save locally to retry or reopen the saved copy.
Local draft could not be opened. Your visible edits are retained but are not saved. Use Reopen saved copy to retry. Stored data will not be reset.

This local draft uses a format this preview cannot read. A compatible reader is required to open it. Your visible edits are retained but are not saved, and stored data will not be reset. Use Manage local drafts to open another draft.

Local draft data could not be verified. A readable copy is required before this draft can be opened. Your visible edits are retained but are not saved, and stored data will not be reset. Use Manage local drafts to open another draft.

This local draft exceeds the read limits of this preview. A reader that supports its size and format is required to open it. Your visible edits are retained but are not saved, and stored data will not be reset. Use Manage local drafts to open another draft.
Save failed. Your visible edits are retained. The previous acknowledged copy is unchanged; retry Save locally or reopen the saved copy.
Another local copy changed. Your edits are retained but were not saved. Reopen the saved copy before editing again; unsaved edits are not overwritten automatically.
Save could not be confirmed. Your edits are retained, and the new copy may already be on disk. Reopen the saved copy before retrying.

Local history, record, or storage limit reached. Your visible edits are not saved; earlier revisions are retained. Reopening restores the saved copy. This preview does not yet support history trimming or export.
Local state needs reconciliation. Your visible edits are retained but are not confirmed saved. Reopen the saved copy before saving again.
This retained revision has missing or unsupported guest form metadata. No replacement form is inferred.

It does not restore domain snapshots, reports or prices. Valid form changes save after a short pause, or Save locally saves them now. The new edit retains history.

Optional user inputs, not catalog facts or measured capacity. Blank means unanswered. Currency uses three uppercase letters. Budget uses a nonnegative decimal with up to 12 fractional digits. Counts use whole digits without leading zeroes; concurrency and latency must be positive. These inputs do not establish placement, compatibility, pricing completeness or T0/T1 readiness.
Some entered workload values are invalid. Your text is retained; correct it before saving.
Unanswered inputs stay unanswered. Valid assumptions save with the form after a short pause, or with Save locally. No evaluation or quote is generated.
That entire edit was rejected because it exceeds the local text buffer. Previous text is unchanged. Edit the text again or reopen before saving.
